methods.municipality: Require literal own-item current seven-digit P3012, municipal P31, exact normalized row/official name, province, compatible row type/null parent, and point covered by the unmodified 2021 StatCan CSD boundary. Hold scope conflicts. Only CSD DGUID 2021A0005 counts admitted.
methods.settlement: Require explicit own-item population-centre or designated-place P31, matching own-item/row/official name, same province, compatible row type, unique containing 2021 PC or DPL boundary; verify any row parent against its own CSD code/boundary. A national PC total may be used only if the official PC has one provincial part.
methods.normalization: Unicode NFKD accent removal, casefold, punctuation removal, Saint/St and Sainte/Ste spelling only. No fuzzy match or population/coordinate-only identity inference.
methods.unresolved: Pinned unresolved_baseline CA keys remain held. No subsequent CA identity events at this pin. Current evidence alone is not a reviewed historical continuity decision.
methods.dated_counts: All rows reviewed, including existing population_year. No pinned CA row has population_year >2021. Existing undated counts matching own-item post-2021 population claims are preserved and held pending primary confirmation. A 2021 CSD missing from the 2025 official CSD register is held for reform identity review. All unverified dated counts remain held, with candidates shown.
methods.boundaries: Original StatCan cartographic geometry with outSR=4326, 7 decimal coordinate precision, no geometry simplification or buffer. Strict covers test; absent/outside boundaries held.
methods.scope: Only population and population_year change. Official population is 2021 Census population count, not dwellings or growth. Suppressed/flagged population cells held.
methods.licences: StatCan table downloads use the Statistics Canada Open Licence; the 2021 boundary service explicitly specifies the Open Government Licence - Canada. Retained licence texts and attribution/adaptation notices cover both.
methods.archives: Archived own-item evidence hash-verified against original capture receipts; capture dates and revision ids retained. Current primary StatCan population/boundary responses downloaded for this audit.
